Game Overview

Pixel Santa Escape puts players into a christmas experience centered on join Santa in a thrilling endless run through a winter wonderland. Collect gifts for points as you leap over obstacles and evade crafty enemies. Beware of airborne threats and use swift kicks to clear your path. Embrace the festive challenge and keep the holiday spirit alive!
